annotations.title: Save a plan for a race

description: Keep what was planned for one race on the user's list, one section at a time: race_plan, fuelling, gear_checklist, travel_notes, stay_booked. race_plan is how to run it (wave, pacing, target time), fuelling what to eat and drink, gear_checklist what to wear and pack, travel_notes how they get there, stay_booked where they sleep once it is booked. Saving a section again replaces it; empty content removes it. Plain text or markdown, 8000 characters at most. get_trip reads the sections back under plans. A dated entry about something that happened is a diary note (add_note), not a plan. Requires signing in.

content.description: The plan itself, plain text or markdown. An empty string removes the section.

race_id.description: id of the race on the user's list, from get_calendar.

section.description: Which part of the plan: race_plan, fuelling, gear_checklist, travel_notes, stay_booked.

title.description: The race name as the list shows it, when there is no id or slug.
